town.label: Town
town.hint: Rest here: HP and mana back to full. A shop inside.

shop.label: Shop
shop.hint: Sells plain gear of this area's rank and potions; it buys what you carry too.

normal.label: Wilds
normal.hint: This area's creatures roam here, and now and then something else turns up.

chest.label: Chest
chest.hint: Gold, and maybe something to wear. Fills again after a while.

potion.label: Potion Spot
potion.hint: Roll a 4 or better for a free potion. Try again after five minutes.

gear.label: Loot Spot
gear.hint: Roll a 4 or better for a piece of basic gear. Try again after five minutes.

spell.label: Shrine
spell.hint: Restores your mana and some HP. Once in a while.

boss.label: Boss
boss.hint: Tap it to challenge it, whenever you choose. Beat it and the way beyond opens.

board.label: Quest Board
board.hint: Walk onto or past it to pick a quest, one at a time. It pays the moment you finish it: xp, gold and a chest.

church.label: Church
church.hint: Heals you fully and takes off poison and weakness. Always open, and free.

arena.label: Arena
arena.hint: Fights in a row, on the days it is open.
